image_prompt.text: A Napoleonic-era old town square built up on all sides as a dense block of modular brick and plaster houses fronting cobblestone streets
Two distinct team base buildings at opposite sides of the square, one French in style and one British, each shielded from the other's sniper lines

Waist-high and full-body cover spread evenly along every cobblestone street — barricades of wooden carts and stacked barrels — with a stone monument fountain standing as cover in the middle of the square
Narrow street mouths and alley gaps where the cobblestone lanes open onto the square, concentrating the fighting on the contested middle
Open upper-storey windows in the brick and plaster houses used as sniper nests, reached only by exposed, predictable stairs
The modular brick and plaster town houses entered from the cobblestone street, so snipers can occupy the rooms behind the open windows

layout_placement.text: Balanced French and British spawns inside the two opposing base buildings at either side of the square, out of each other's sniper sightlines

notes: would have asked: offered the Team Deathmatch preset in plain language — two opposing team bases at either side of the square, cover arrays along every street, pinch points where the streets open onto the middle — plus the sniper windows and the enterable houses the prompt named, since the preset lacks them. Taken as offered, because the prompt describes exactly that map; the preset's own shape (lane network) was kept, with the cobblestone streets read as the lanes and the square as the contested middle.

would have asked: confirm that snipers actually go inside the brick and plaster houses to use the open windows, rather than the houses being facades with exterior balconies. Read as enterable, which is the only thing putting P3 in the route; if they are facades, drop building-interior and the route is ['P0 + tiered'] alone.
would have asked: anything else you want in the space?

P3 is not ready yet, so the house interiors are a deferral to flag: the square, the streets, the two bases, the barricades and the sniper windows all build on the proven pipeline; only going indoors needs the outside-to-inside pass. cover-elevated is P0 + tiered rather than P2 because windows in the housefronts do not overhang the street below.
settlement-density is a Universal Option, taken because the prompt asks for an old town square of modular houses rather than scattered buildings, and bent to the prompt's cobblestone town fabric.
The central monument fountain is folded into cover-los as central cover rather than emitted as water-body — the prompt wants it as cover, not as a water feature, so no CHECK is incurred.
Kept to a single genre: 'snipers' and two-team combat are firing-corridor and sightline design, and nothing in the prompt describes a shared melee clash space, so Action was not named.
